crosswalks.label: Statisticians
crosswalks.rationale: O*NET directly describes statisticians, including survey statisticians, and matches the package's inference/design/analysis domain.

crosswalks.label: Mathematicians, actuaries and statisticians (contains statistician/biometrician)
crosswalks.rationale: ESCO places statistician under this broader unit group and provides narrower occupation concepts.

crosswalks.label: Mathematicians and Statisticians OOH profile
crosswalks.rationale: The BLS profile combines mathematicians and statisticians but supplies useful public-domain duty and communication/work-context evidence.

findings.summary: O*NET strongly supports selecting appropriate statistical methods, data preparation/quality review, model analysis and reporting results.
findings.rationale: The body already emphasizes estimands, data lineage, modeling, diagnostics, sensitivity, uncertainty and reproducibility.

findings.summary: O*NET and BLS include designing surveys, experiments/opinion polls, sampling techniques and determining what data are needed, not only analyzing an already-given dataset.
findings.rationale: The body mentions experimental design/sampling knowledge but its core procedure begins with a dataset context and does not reconstruct instrument/data-collection design deeply.

findings.summary: Public occupation evidence explicitly includes analytical reports, graphs/visualizations and communication to technical and nontechnical audiences.
findings.rationale: The body outputs an evidence packet but lacks a first-class statistical communication/visualization skill and audience-specific interpretation procedure.

findings.summary: BLS describes statisticians solving problems across business, engineering, sciences and other fields, making domain collaboration part of normal practice.
findings.rationale: The current body consults Methodologist and Data Engineer but could represent a generic domain-stakeholder handoff for practical meaning and decision context.

gaps_against_body.description: Deepen survey/experiment/sampling and data-collection design before analysis, including instrument/data requirements and its boundary with Research Methodologist.
Add statistical reporting/visualization and audience-specific communication as explicit professional machinery while preserving uncertainty and avoiding decision authority.
Add a generic domain-owner consultation contract for practical meaning, costs and decision relevance beyond statistical inference.

nonclaims: This packet does not claim that the Statistician body is validated across biostatistics, official statistics, survey statistics, experimentation, forecasting or every statistical specialty.
Public occupation profiles describe common work, not a guarantee that every statistician performs every listed task.
No numerical method is promoted merely because it appears in an occupational source.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No authorization or regulated-practice claim is created by this research packet.
